_about: The BRANDS' OWN catalogue figures behind the brand page texts — the whole brand, not what the shop stocks. TWO LAYERS. (1) THE RECORD, never printed: `figures` — each read from the brand's OFFICIAL sources (its own site and catalogue, its group's official pages, official press material) with the `source` URL, `how` it was read or counted, and the brand's `checked_on` date; `left_out` — what was not found, with the reason (nothing is estimated; a third party's estimate is never written as the brand's number); `sources` — every page read. (2) THE PAGE: `page.families` (the family / collection / line names the shop presents as the brand's range) and `page.facts` (plain label-value facts about that range: movements, sizes, materials). `php artisan seo:seed-texts` prints ONLY the `page` block, as the range available at the shop — with NO date, NO outbound link, NO source note and NO comparison between the brand's catalogue and ours (the developer's decision, 2026-11-05); a brand's own COUNTS ("18 families", "more than 1,000 models") are in the record and are not printed. Every name and fact in `page` must be backed by a figure of the same entry (a test holds the file to that). TO REFRESH: open each `sources[].url`, re-read, update `figures` (`value`, `how`), `checked_on` and then `page`; run `php artisan seo:seed-texts --storefront=<code> --overwrite --apply`. OUR catalogue's numbers are in facts.json (`php artisan seo:count-facts`).
